item.title: New York woman is convicted of Islamic State training after becoming a teen bride to a fighter
item.description: A New York woman whose father took her to Syria as a teenager and arranged her marriage to an Islamic State fighter has been convicted of receiving weapons training from the militant group.

item.title: Judge to consider whether California should count 20,000 ballots disputed by Trump administration
item.description: A federal judge in Los Angeles is set to hear arguments over whether the Department of Justice can bar California from counting the ballots of of some 20,000 people until it can confirm they are U.S. citizens.

item.title: Alex Pretti's parents say federal government is shielding agents involved in his killing
item.description: It's been nine months since intensive care nurse Alex Pretti was killed by federal officers during the Trump administration's immigration enforcement surge in Minneapolis.
